deadline_text_verbatim: The deadline to apply for Georgia Tech financial aid is January 31, 2026. ... you must complete the 2026-27 Georgia Tech Application for Scholarships and Financial Aid ... Fall First year - the CSS profile due date is January 31.
limitations: CRITICAL CYCLE-YEAR OFFSET, exactly the risk this research brief flagged (per the wave-1 Columbia agent's finding on this same pattern): Georgia Tech's financial aid office labels this deadline by ACADEMIC/ENROLLMENT year ('2026-27 academic year' = Fall 2026 entry = cycle_year 2026 under this schema's entry-year convention), while Georgia Tech's ADMISSIONS office labels its concurrent application cycle by a DIFFERENT convention ('2026-27 application cycle' = Fall 2027 entry = cycle_year 2027, confirmed via the essay-policy announcement cited on REQ-2026-08-21-GAT0003). These two '2026-27' labels, from two different official Georgia Tech subdomains, refer to entry years exactly one year apart. This deadline record (cycle_year 2026) is NOT the financial aid deadline for the same Fall-2027-entry cohort as this batch's EA1/EA2/RD admissions deadline records (cycle_year 2027, DL-2026-08-21-GAT0001 through GAT0009) -- do not merge or conflate them. As of this research pass's retrieval date (2026-08-21), finaid.gatech.edu/apply/fall-first-year is the CURRENT LIVE page and still shows only this 2026-27/Fall-2026 cycle data; Georgia Tech's financial aid office had not yet published Fall-2027-entry (2027-28 academic year) figures at retrieval time. See companion record DL-2026-08-21-GAT0011 for the explicit not-yet-published finding for cycle_year 2027. GT App and CSS Profile are not inherently citizenship-restricted on this page, but FAFSA (bundled into the same deadline) is federal aid and is domestic/eligible-noncitizen-only by law; Georgia Tech's own international aid page (see requirement record REQ-2026-08-21-GAT0011) separately states international students are generally ineligible for the institutional aid this deadline gates anyway, so applies_to='both' should be read narrowly -- the deadline date is procedurally the same for whoever applies, but its practical relevance skews strongly domestic.
researcher_notes: Georgia Tech's own pattern (an 'Apply Now: Financial Aid Forms Available for [year]' announcement published at news.em.gatech.edu on 2025-10-01 for this 2026-27/Fall-2026 cycle) suggests an equivalent 2027-28/Fall-2027 announcement would plausibly appear around October 2026 -- noted as a plausible pattern for a FUTURE research pass to re-check, explicitly NOT asserted as a fact and NOT used to synthesize a projected 2027 date in this record.
